system.description:
Weapon Kit — A healing kit with temp HP, burst heals, cleansing and stim options.

Med Blaster (basic) — 1 Action. Reach 2. Target gains INT temp HP, 1 round. If they are Bloodied they regain HP instead.

Toolbelt (2 Actions):

  • Vital Burst. Cone 2, Restore: 2xINT HP.
  • Cleansing Mist. Burst 2, Restore: 1d4 HP. Targets heal 1 negative condition.
  • Stim Pack. Reach 2. Ally gains +2 speed and +1 Max Actions on their next turn. They are Dazed for 1 turn at the end of the round.

High Levels: +2 bonus every 5 levels (Med Blaster, Vital Burst, Cleansing Mist).

[M] Weapon Kits are considered weapons for swapping and stowing. The basic ability costs 1 Action; each Toolbelt option costs 2 Actions and 1 Toolbelt scrap. Scrap cost is tracked by the module.
